body:
This problem only occurs for `>` predicates, because they are translated into `DISJOINT` queries, while `<` predicates are translated into `INTERSECTS` queries:
* `INTERSECTS` with an invalid shape will give no results (correct answer)
* `DISJOINT` with an invalid shape will return all documents (which is correct from the definition of DISJOINT, but not correct from the definition of the ES|QL predicate, which means we need to evaluate the validity of the shape before using DISJOINT)

issue.title: Added geometry validation for GEO types to exit early on invalid latitudes

issue.body:
It turns out in #128234 that Lucene pushdown on ST_DISTANCE with invalid points (latitude out of range) will cause all documents to be returned, since DISJOINT on an invalid circle is true for all documents. We could either add an extra check for spatial pushdown that the geometries are valid, or add validation at geometry creation. This second option is much easier to implement, and a more comprehensive approach, as it prevents invalid geometries in many more places, hopefully reducing the likelihood of subtle and obscure bugs like #128234 happening in future.

Fixes #128234
